name: bite_down_a_negative_power_deals_no_damage
notes: Printed: 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.' A negative number an effect uses counts as 0 (CR 107.1b). Seat 0's Gnome is printed 1/3; Stab (-2/-2 until end of turn) makes it -1/1, and Bite Down then has it deal 0 damage: seat 1's Colossus has no damage marked and no life changes (it is not healed either).
